caption: The drawing depicts a two-story house with a green roof, two red chimneys, and light purple or white walls. The house features multiple windows and a prominent staircase leading up to a covered entryway on the front side. Surrounding the house are several green-leaved trees of varying sizes and shapes, as well as an area of grass and a dirt path curving toward the entrance. There is a light purple picket fence along the left and front boundary of the property, and a small outbuilding or shed is visible in the background to the left. The entire scene is rendered in watercolor with soft, pastel-like tones, and the background is light beige, giving an impression of either early morning or soft daylight.
title: Grenseback Estate
